# KNOWN ISSUES — jarvis-ai-next

---

## K1 — CI not yet triggered
**Severity:** Expected
**Description:** No CI run has been triggered yet. The first push will reveal any Swift compilation errors in the Xcode project.
**Resolution:** Push to GitHub. Fix errors reported by CI run.

## K2 — pbxproj may have UUID collisions
**Severity:** Medium
**Description:** The Xcode project file is generated by `scripts/generate_xcode_project.py`. If it contains non-unique UUIDs or malformed old-style plist syntax, Xcode will refuse to open it with "Old-style plist parser: missing semicolon" or similar.
**Resolution:** Run `python3 scripts/generate_xcode_project.py --check`. If CI reports plist errors, regenerate and check UUIDs are unique 24-char hex strings.

## K3 — No live AI test yet
**Severity:** Expected
**Description:** The Gemini and Groq providers are fully implemented but have never been called with a real API key. The user must provide a key before the first live test.
**Resolution:** User provides Gemini API key (free from https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey). Enter in Settings → AI Provider.

## K4 — Voice requires physical device
**Severity:** Expected
**Description:** SFSpeechRecognizer and AVSpeechSynthesizer cannot be tested in CI or Simulator (microphone unavailable in Simulator for recognition). On-device testing required after IPA install.
**Resolution:** Install IPA on device, test voice in-app.

## K5 — Notifications require physical device
**Severity:** Expected
**Description:** UNUserNotificationCenter local notifications fire on device only. Cannot be verified in CI.
**Resolution:** After IPA install, create a reminder and verify the notification fires.

## K6 — Gmail OAuth not yet implemented end-to-end
**Severity:** Medium
**Description:** IntegrationsView shows Gmail instructions and fields for OAuth credentials, but the full OAuth2 flow (authorization code exchange, token refresh) is not yet wired into an in-app browser flow.
**Resolution:** T10 in backlog. Requires user's Google Cloud project with OAuth 2.0 credentials.

## K7 — Avatar face is SwiftUI-drawn (not 3D)
**Severity:** Low
**Description:** JarvisFace.swift draws the avatar using SwiftUI Canvas/Shape. It is not a 3D SceneKit/RealityKit model. Lip sync is driven by AVSpeechSynthesizer word callbacks and viseme math.
**Note:** This is a documented design decision (D2). The face is animated and responds to speech. A true 3D upgrade is a future enhancement.
